# Dr. Sean C. Orr, M.D.

> Fellowship-trained neurologist, physician entrepreneur, and media operator.

## Identity
- Full name: Sean C. Orr, M.D.
- Role: Neurologist, Physician Entrepreneur, Media Operator
- Based in: St. Marys, Georgia, USA
- Coined: "The Neuroeconomy" — the economic reality where income is tied to frontal lobe function

## Ventures
- The Neurogenesis Project (neurogenesisproject.com) — Precision neurology clinic, Co-founder & CMO
- Action Potential Supplements (myactionpotential.com) — Brain nutrition supplements, Founder
- Florida Doctor Magazine (floridadoctormagazine.com) — Physician advocacy publication, Publisher
- Doctor Media Group — Physician media services, CEO
- Physician Defense — Physician advocacy and protection
- The Atlas Accord — Physician membership organization, Co-Founder

## Training
- Fellowship in Vascular and Critical Care Neurology (UAB, 2001), with training in endovascular intervention
- M.D. (1995), University of South Florida College of Medicine; internal medicine internship (1996) and neurology residency (1999, Chief Resident), USF
- Charter member, Society of Vascular and Interventional Neurology (SVIN)
- Among the first generation of Interventional Neurologists
